definition: Creates a dedicated cloud environment for one organisation using pooled, automated and self-service infrastructure.
Creates a shared cloud platform serving multiple government institutions or public bodies.
Upgrades an existing private or government cloud for automation, scalability, resilience or new service capabilities.
Provides shared container orchestration, databases, integration, development or other managed platform services.
Introduces service catalogues, provisioning, metering, tenant management, monitoring and operational processes.
